title: Murder of Prince Santhakumar (Saravana Bhavan case)
narrative: FIR — Murder of Prince Santhakumar, Tamil Nadu. P. Rajagopal, the founder of the Saravana Bhavan restaurant chain, sought to marry Jeevajothi, who had instead married Prince Santhakumar, a mathematics teacher in Chennai. After repeated attempts to coerce her, Rajagopal employed a gang to abduct Santhakumar in October 2001; Santhakumar was murdered and his body was found in Kodaikanal. A sessions court convicted Rajagopal and his accomplices in 2004; the Madras High Court enhanced the sentence to life imprisonment, which the Supreme Court upheld on 29 March 2019.
